/-- A bounded scan reports exhaustion explicitly and never returns a partial table. -/
def D_J_checked : Nat → ByteArray → Nat → Array UInt256 → Option (Array UInt256)
  | 0, _, _, _ => none
  | fuel + 1, c, pc, result =>
    match c.get? pc >>= EvmYul.EVM.parseInstr with
    | none => some result
    | some op =>
      D_J_checked fuel c (pc + 1 + argOnNBytesOfInstr op)
        (if op = .JUMPDEST then result.push (UInt256.ofNat pc) else result)

/-- On nonwrapping images use a terminating natural-cursor scan.
    The original opaque scanner remains the fallback; None is not a partial table. -/
def D_J (c : ByteArray) (i : UInt256) : Array UInt256 :=
  if c.size + 32 < UInt256.size then
    match D_J_checked (c.size - i.toNat + 1) c i.toNat #[] with
    | some result => result
    | none => D_J_aux c i #[]
  else
    D_J_aux c i #[]
